reasoning: Encode a payload alternating7E/7D and derive CRC placement and maximum wire length.
Derive and bound: CRC covers unescaped header/payload, then body including CRC is escaped. Body<=47 and worst wire<=96; CRC check123456789 is29B1. CRC over escaped bytes is a different wire contract.
Separate original model policy, ISO C, protocol, vendor register and electrical claims; state ownership, failure publication and costs.
